title: Fair and balanced communications
description: Communications must be fair and balanced and must not contain exaggerated, unwarranted, promissory, or misleading claims.

title: Unsupported performance claims
description: Performance claims should have an identifiable and reasonable evidentiary basis.

title: Misleading return representations
description: Representations of investment returns must not create a misleading impression.

title: Risk representation
description: Statements about investment risk must not misleadingly imply that an investment has no risk.

title: Historical performance context
description: Historical performance should not be presented in a way that implies future results are certain.

title: Guaranteed financial outcomes
description: Claims promising a guaranteed financial outcome require careful compliance review.

title: Potential conflict of interest
description: Statements involving incentives or interests that could affect recommendations should be reviewed.

title: Absolute or exaggerated claims
description: Absolute claims about financial products should be checked for misleading or unsupported wording.

title: Claims requiring supporting evidence
description: Material factual claims should be supported by appropriate evidence.

title: Sensitive information disclosure
description: Disclosure of personal or confidential information should be reviewed for appropriate authorization.
